children: Avemio AG expects preliminary FY25 revenue of about €79.8M (vs €87.9M prior) and EBIT of €-5.4M to €-6.5M, below its forecast for revenue improvement and a return to positive EBIT. Impairments of €14M–€16M will be recognized; figures are preliminary and unaudited.
Signals weaker demand vs 2024 and a miss vs prior guidance of slight improvement.
Guided for positive EBIT; miss implies deeper losses than 2024 (€-4.7M).
One-off charges tied to insolvency weigh on earnings and equity.
Core demand softness plus lower digital profit reduce visibility.
Outcome uncertain; restructuring is key to stabilizing the group.

This is a late-stage confirmation of deteriorating fundamentals and guidance miss after prior expectations for improvement. A resolved Teltec plan, demand recovery, and removal of one-offs would be needed to restore confidence and catalyze upside.
